name: Dalaran
summary: Dalaran was once the shining magocratic capital of the Kirin Tor, nestled on the southern shore of Lordamere Lake. Shattered by the Scourge and the demon lord Archimonde during the Third War, its surviving magi are rebuilding the city, having removed its protective violet shield early in the reconstruction.

sections.title: Fall of the Magocracy
sections.body: Founded after the ancient Troll Wars by sorcerers of the Arathorian Empire, Dalaran stood for centuries as humanity's premier sanctuary for arcane study. Under the leadership of the Council of Six, the Kirin Tor amassed vast magical archives and guarded powerful artifacts within the Violet Citadel. That age of splendor ended abruptly during the Third War. The traitor prince Arthas led the Scourge through the city gates to seize the Book of Medivh, and soon after, the demon lord Archimonde crushed Dalaran's soaring spires into rubble.

sections.title: Rebuilding the Magocracy
sections.body: In the aftermath of the Legion's defeat, the surviving wizards of the Kirin Tor returned to their devastated homeland. Refusing to surrender their ancestral ground to the Scourge or scavengers, they erected an impassable, shimmering violet barrier over the city's heart. In Forever, they removed the shield early, while the city was still under reconstruction. The magi continue rebuilding their fallen sanctuary, and Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver can be found in the Violet Citadel.

faq.q: What became of Dalaran's protective shield?
faq.answer: The Kirin Tor erected a magical shield over Dalaran after its destruction in the Third War. In Forever, they removed it early while the city was still being rebuilt.
Yes. In Forever, Dalaran is accessible while reconstruction is still underway. Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver resides in the Violet Citadel.

Dalaran was attacked by Prince Arthas and his Scourge army, who stole the Book of Medivh from its vaults. Shortly after, the demon lord Archimonde summoned dark sorcery to pulverize the city into ruins.
The city is governed by the Kirin Tor, an elite magocratic order led by a ruling assembly known as the Council of Six.

angles.text: Dalaran is the historical cradle of human and high elven wizardry. Seeing its legendary spires still being rebuilt serves as a solemn reminder of the devastating losses mages suffered in the Third War.
Dalaran was one of the seven founding kingdoms of the original Alliance of Lordaeron, and the Kirin Tor is rebuilding its devastated capital.
